nodes.name: DiffStatsBadge.md
nodes.summary: UI-consistency audit of the DiffStatsBadge component consolidation (commit afdd30bf), covering the new `plain` variant, its prop surface, and ~18 migrated diff-stat call sites across chat blocks, code viewers, the git dashboard, kanban, and inbox. Documents raw-HTML, Tailwind-token, hardcoded-color, and accessibility findings plus a flagged font-size externalization sweep candidate for the `plain` variant.

nodes.name: OrphanedDiffStatsSCSS.md
nodes.summary: UI audit tracking dead diff-stat pill CSS left behind in ModernSplitDiff.scss after the DiffStatsBadge migration removed the equivalent hardcoded-hex pill rules from two sibling stylesheets (CodeViewer/index.scss and GitHubDiff/index.scss). Flags two orphaned, unreachable `.header-stats.additions`/`.header-stats.deletions` selectors as a fix candidate and confirms the resulting pill-to-plain-text visual change is an intentional, design-wide simplification.

nodes.name: SharedComponentMemoization.md
nodes.summary: UI-consistency audit of a perf-only memoization batch (useMemo/React.memo applied to Button, Tag, StackListRow, Menu, Checkbox, Radio, Collapse, and Form) that confirms zero UI/design-system surface was touched, with a watch-list note on Button's pre-existing inline-style sizing literals for a future dedicated audit.
